summary: Swedish Export Credit Corporation (SEK) filed a routine Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, furnishing legal opinions and consents tied to its previously priced offering of US$1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Medium-Term Notes, Series H, 4.500% Notes due June 11, 2031, issued under its Form F-3 shelf and 1991 Indenture as supplemented. No special-situation event, ownership change, or strategic action is present; the filing is an ordinary debt shelf takedown exhibit submission. Watch only for standard settlement mechanics and any renewal or additional Series H tranches under the same program.
